breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the instruction 'Use the convective-tip fin formula that includes tip convection,' which directly repeats the original error. While it also says 'Consider the tip to be adiabatic,' these two instructions are contradictory. The ground truth explicitly requires using the adiabatic-tip fin solution and NOT a convective-tip boundary condition.
